acceptanceCriteria: A proposed KHN spec amendment (human acceptance required) defines repository-qualified anchors, prefixed scope matching and per-repository freshness, with fail-closed handling of unknown aliases.
After acceptance: implementation with focused and hostile tests including a two-repository fixture, sealed change evidence; GitHub #687 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#687, follow-up to #671 (V1-0987, KHN-V0-021..023) on main-ecfff8e. ticket know-how add pins --anchor blobs at --commit (default HEAD of the working directory) and finds the task store from the working directory; a WORKER add also needs every anchor inside the ticket's effects.touchPaths. Programs whose queue lives in one repository while tickets touch others (touchPaths namespaced by repository prefix) cannot add WORKER know-how: from the store directory only queue-repository files can be pinned, from the work repository the store is not found, and repository-relative anchors never match prefixed touchPaths. Ask: name the anchor's repository (--repo ALIAS=ROOT as appmap build does, or --anchor ALIAS:path pinned against that root's HEAD), match WORKER scope against touchPaths with the same repository prefix, and compute claim-time freshness against that repository's HEAD; alternatively a store-location flag plus a documented touchPath-prefix-to-root mapping.
